notes.title: YSNJ v1.1 is ready for jumps!
notes.content:
In view of the successful game launch, the World Government announces an amnesty. Prisoners will be released...  [spoiler] Never. Don't even hope.
 [/spoiler] 
And now for the bad news. Constant earthquakes led to the following changes:
[list]
    [*]Significant improvement in the game's balance
    [*]Read notes are now displayed in a different color
    [*]Fixed a problem preventing the laser from being used in rare situations
    [*]Notes now have a fully working scroll on low resolution displays
    [*]Fixed a problem in the game final
    [*]Fixed bugs not allowing to get some achievements
[/list]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29248628/b4f8e565b1979611853edafd0e1d95c1c637cc19.jpg[/img]

notes.title: YSNJ v1.01 patch had been released!
notes.content:
Hello, fellow citizens!

World Government announces patch 1.01 which contains fixes acquired based on feedback from our first enthusiasts:
[list]
    [*]Low resolution interface glitches
    [*]Translation corrections
    [*]Tutorial bug fixes
    [*]Sound settings minor fix
    [*]Achievements bug fixes
    [*]Additional game balancing
[/list]
We're glad to announce that the next patch will bring additional content, so stay tuned on World Government News!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29248628/b4f8e565b1979611853edafd0e1d95c1c637cc19.jpg[/img]
